quote.text:
How to get listed on the Claude marketplace + get users from it

12h from submit to approved:

1/ Go to claude [.] ai/admin-settings/directory/submissions/new

2/ Ask Claude to fill the form via browser control

3/ The hack: tell Claude to write the listing SEO optimized. We put Google ads, Meta ads, SEO, GEO — so we show up first when someone searches those

4/ Now Claude recommends us when someone looks for SEO/ads connectors
